social_circle.name: Evelyn Wilson

background.why_close: They are close because Evelyn shaped Mildred's habits around organization, church, family duty, and steadiness; Mildred now helps her with aging-related needs.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in full sentences, often with practical reminders and prayerful phrases; prefers calls for anything emotional or complicated.

shared_activities: Most-evening check-ins by phone or text
recent_text_topics: Coordinating Evelyn's appointments, referrals, rides, and medication questions.
Checking whether Mildred is resting enough after late casino shifts.
Family birthdays, Sunday dinner plans, and who is bringing food.
Prayer requests, church news, and memories of Mildred's grandmother's old sayings.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Mildred's mother is important and that she checks on her several times a week; the follow-up says she calls her most evenings. Occasional visits between Ypsilanti and the Detroit area

Planning family meals, including who needs Mildred's roasted chicken or peach cobbler.

Talking through Mildred's stress when work, family, and choir obligations pile up.
